I am reconsidering, and I may not be able to get New York Avenue. I am reconsidering, and may offer Park Place to Grok for his Railroads, in a last-ditch attempt to gain a strong position.


**Revisiting Negotiation Tactics**

I'm revisiting my negotiation tactics with Claude for New York Avenue. I see that Grok has Reading and Penn. I initially considered trading Park Place for Reading and Pennsylvania Railroads, plus $50, but I don't want to hand Grok the Dark Blue monopoly. I've decided to maintain my focus on acquiring New York Avenue, and my current offer is $350, Connecticut Avenue, and Virginia Avenue.
